description: M29 WP-E: shared ZIP entry contract fixture. Every entry must produce an IDENTICAL verdict across the three layers: JS validateZipEntry (scripts/release-artifact-contract.mjs), scripts/_zip_helper.py, and .github/workflows/scripts/verify_release_zip.py. Windows drive absolute / drive-relative and UNC paths must be rejected by all three layers.
